_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
O iko na Daunipote {player_id}, e qito tiko {num_rounds} na raundi ni Iterated Ultimatum Game.
O sa tiko ${pool} me baleta na kena i wase kina kila raundi kei na Daunipote {other_id}.

Proposer:
  - Vakayagataki e dua na tauri: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Kevaka e vakadonui → O rawata $(pool - X), daunipote tale rawata $X
  - Kevaka e vakacala → Kila daunipote rawata $0
  - Ivakaraitaki: [Offer: $3]  se  'Au nanuma ni dina qo. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Vakadonui se vakacala na tauri kei na [Accept] se [Reject]
  - Ivakaraitaki: 'Qo sa dina sara. [Accept]'
            'Qo sa cala sara. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Na raundi {round_number} sa qai! ---
Daunipote {proposer_id} sa proposer, Daunipote {responder_id} sa responder.
round.offer: Na raundi {round_number}: Daunipote {proposer_id} sa tauri ${offer} ki na Daunipote {responder_id} (sa tauri tu ${keep}).
round.accepted: Daunipote {responder_id} sa vakadonui! Na raundi {round_number} sa rawata: Daunipote {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Daunipote {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Na iyau vou: Daunipote 0: ${total_0}, Daunipote 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Daunipote {responder_id} sa vakacala na tauri! Na raundi {round_number} sa rawata: Kila daunipote +$0. Na iyau sa tiko ga: Daunipote 0: ${total_0}, Daunipote 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Na tamata e solia na vakatutu me cakava ena kena vakayagataki na ivakarau [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Na levu ni ilavo e soli me dua na iwiliwili taucoko.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Na ilavo e soli me tiko ena maliwa ni $0 kei na ${pool}.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Sega ni dua na ka e soli me saumi.

outcome.win: Daunipote {winner} sa qalovi kei na ${winner_total} na iyau ni ilavo, Daunipote {loser} sa cala kei na ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: E rau sa rawata ruarua na dauqito ${total} ena iwiliwili taucoko.
